newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, hoteliers firm.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, hoteliers firm.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed the week mixed on Friday in slower trade marked by poor performance of the leading issues and new gains among hoteliers.
* Six of 14 active issues rose, three were flat and five fell.
* Volume almost halved to 9,249 units, turnover to 3.6 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer hotelier Istraturist added 10 kuna or 5.6 percent to 190, on volume of 836 shares.
* Biggest decliner cable maker Elka lost 12 kuna or 7.1 percent to 145, with 77 units sold.
* Most active issue food concern Podravka edged down 8 kuna to 275, selling 3,877 shares.
